# Private Git authentication on Ubuntu

[Workflow](../workflows/15014.yml) for
[actions/runner-images#15014](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/15014).

## Setup

1. Add an Actions secret named `PAT` to the repository containing this workflow.
   Use a fine-grained PAT with **Contents: Read-only** and access to the target
   private repository, or a classic PAT with `repo` scope. Authorize SSO if required.
   Do not put the token in workflow inputs.
2. Add an Actions secret named `REPRO_REPO` containing `owner/repo`,
   without a URL or `.git` suffix.
   The repository must be private and should contain at least one commit.
3. Run **Repro private Git fetch authentication (15014)** manually.
   No workflow inputs are required; all matrix jobs consume `PAT` and `REPRO_REPO`.
4. Inspect the job log for image/package versions and the job summary for results.
   Private ref names, repository metadata, and credentials are not printed or uploaded.

The workflow does not create a private repository or substitute a public one.
The default `GITHUB_TOKEN` of this public workflow repository cannot read an
unrelated private repository, so an explicit PAT is required.

The matrix runs five independent jobs per label: `ubuntu-22.04`, `ubuntu-22.04-arm`,
`ubuntu-24.04`, `ubuntu-24.04-arm`, `ubuntu-26.04`, `ubuntu-26.04-arm`,
`ubuntu-latest`, and `ubuntu-slim` (40 jobs total). A failed job does not
cancel the remaining samples. Job names identify the label and sample number;
logs also record the runner architecture. `ubuntu-latest` is an alias, not
an additional Ubuntu release. Slim runs in a container rather than a full VM.

## Comparison and workaround

On the same unmodified runner, for both the issue's URL without `.git` and a URL
with `.git`, the diagnostic runs `git ls-remote -q --end-of-options` using:

```bash
# Original: token as username, no password.
git config --global url."https://${TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"

# Workaround: nonempty username, token as password.
git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"
```

These are alternatives, not rules to install together. Remove the old rule
when applying the workaround in an existing job. In the diagnostic, each probe
has its own temporary global configuration and working directory. Checkout
credentials, helpers, tracing, and inherited Git settings cannot authenticate
the probes accidentally. Temporary credential files are removed on exit.

The same libcurl package regression and successful `x-access-token:<PAT>`
comparison are reported in
[renovatebot/renovate discussion 47071](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/discussions/47071)
and its
[maintainer response](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/discussions/47071#discussioncomment-18947589).
This supports testing the credential-format workaround, but does not prove
that every failure in the runner-images issue has the same cause. No security
packages are downgraded.

## Interpretation

- Original fails with `could not read Username`, workaround passes:
  issue signature reproduced and workaround verified on this VM.
- Both pass: not reproduced on this VM, not proof that the regression is fixed.
- Workaround fails, or original fails for a different reason: job fails, and
  the result is inconclusive rather than reported as a successful workaround.
- Missing token, API access failure, or a public target: explicit preflight failure.

The issue reports failure on image `20261018.339.1` and success on
`20261012.334.1`. The `ubuntu-24.04` label cannot pin either hosted image.
Rerun while images are rolling out and compare the recorded `ImageVersion`.
Protocol v2 is explicitly selected so that `ls-remote` exercises the follow-up
upload-pack request involved in the reported regression.

Local checks:

```bash
actionlint .github/workflows/15014.yml
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 .github/scripts/15014-diagnostics.test.py -v
```

Older actionlint versions may not recognize the officially available Ubuntu
26.04 labels. For those versions, use
`actionlint -ignore 'label "ubuntu-26\.04(-arm)?" is unknown' .github/workflows/15014.yml`
to suppress only those outdated label warnings.
